# Local test fixtures

People, biographies, and lists are fictional. Restaurant names, addresses, websites, and image URLs are public examples, not a statement of current Blackbird participation.

The fixture images come from the restaurants’ own websites: [Rubirosa](https://www.rubirosanyc.com/), [Thai Diner](https://www.thaidiner.com/), and [BINX](https://www.binxnyc.com/). Image rights remain with their respective owners. No image files are bundled here.
